segments.ja322:1.1: Duddubhāyati [daddabhāyati (sī. pī.)] bhaddante, yasmiṃ dese vasāmahaṃ;
segments.ja322:2.1: Beluvaṃ patitaṃ sutvā, duddubhanti [daddabhanti (sī.)] saso javi;
segments.ja322:4.1: Ye ca sīlena sampannā, paññāyūpasame ratā;
segments.ja322:4.3: Ārakā viratā dhīrā, na honti parapattiyāti.
